title: Black Bustier Loft
reference_source: Бельевая линия — максимальный гламурный регистр, 8 кадров, без наушников
mood_ru: Бетон, жёсткий свет из высоких окон, чёрный бюстье на косточках. Графично и дерзко.
allure: lingerie editorial glamour at its boldest, set with full opaque lining, deep neckline and high-cut briefs, sculpted waist and long legs fully on show, unhurried commanding sensuality, direct gaze, boned bustier pulling the waist in hard, graphic black against raw concrete
film: shot on Kodak Ektar 100, tight grain and deep blacks

wardrobe.notes_ru: Чёрный бюстье на косточках + высокие трусики, плотная ткань, чулки.
wardrobe.prompt: black boned bustier with structured cups and visible seams, opaque matte fabric, matching high-waisted black briefs, sheer black stockings, silver star pendant, hair in a sleek low bun with loose strands, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Пустой бетонный лофт, высокие окна, минимум мебели.
location.prompt: empty industrial loft, raw concrete floor and columns, tall steel-framed windows, peeling white paint, a single wooden stool, dust in the light shafts, cold daylight

shots.pose: standing with her back against the concrete column in the black bustier and high-waisted briefs, one heel propped behind her, both hands behind her lower back, chest lifted, level stare at the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: hard shaft of daylight from the high loft window cutting across her torso

shots.pose: sitting on the bare concrete floor with one leg stretched long and the other bent up, leaning back on both hands, shoulders open, head tipped back then turned to hold the camera
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at floor level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: raking window light along the floor and her legs, hard shadow shapes on the concrete

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the bare concrete floor, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: hard directional daylight from the tall window, cold bounce off the pale concrete wall behind her

shots.pose: standing close to the leaning sheet of glass against the wall, one hand flat on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, meeting the camera past her own reflection
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: hard directional daylight from the tall window, cold bounce off the pale concrete wall behind her

shots.pose: standing at the tall steel-framed loft window with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, the long line of her back and legs read against the light, head turned just enough to find the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: hard directional daylight from the tall window, cold bounce off the pale concrete wall behind her

shots.pose: reclining back on the bare concrete floor propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: hard directional daylight from the tall window, cold bounce off the pale concrete wall behind her

shots.pose: standing tall in the middle of the empty concrete floor, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight on one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: hard directional daylight from the tall window, cold bounce off the pale concrete wall behind her

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the boning seams of the bustier across her ribs and her hand resting there, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: hard directional daylight from the tall window, cold bounce off the pale concrete wall behind her
